weighted: w=2*r-1 on normalized Support ratings only
positive_negative: mean unit vectors of Support r>=.7 minus beta*mean unit vectors of Support r<=.3; intermediate ignored; beta .25/.50
signed_scale: clip(cosine,0,1); no fitted calibration, negative similarities receive zero
profile_fallback: All Support ratings equal or zero signed vector -> original positive rating-weighted Content; unavailable Content -> original component/popularity fallback
pure_content: Original Content.score, then popularity ONLY when missing; no MF fallback
selection: Mean5 fold positive-user NDCG then Recall/HitRate; strict baseline improvement; ties prefer original, then fewer new parameters, alpha closer .25
comparisons: baseline Hybrid .25, Pure MF, Pure Content, 3 new profiles x3 alphas; one cached score array per Support/profile; all combinations preregistered, no further search
scope: Exact V26 developer50, 5x40/10, Support5, candidates479, relevance .7; reserved25 excluded, no V24 result reads; reused development CV not final
